title: feat(fields,app-shell): the capability select lists the capability registry; the matrix badge reads the layered envelope (part of objectui#7611)
body:
Part of #7611
Clause-②: no

PR-1 of the objectui#7611 remainder, as the seat's claim amendment on objectui#7611 (comment 6111342697) dispatched it: census item 1 (the capability select), census row 1b (the Capabilities catalog page) and F2 (the permission-set editor's "Custom" badge). objectui#7611 stays open: items 3, 4 and 5 and row 8c are other PRs.

Clause-② is `no`: no export is added or removed and no exported type changes. `CapabilityMultiSelectField` keeps its props type; what changes is where its options come from (below), and it no longer reads the `dataSource` prop.

## What changed

**Item 1: the capability select lists the capability registry.** `CapabilityMultiSelectField` (`@object-ui/fields`) reads the `capability` items of the console metadata store (`MetadataCtx` `ensureType`, which is `GET /api/v1/meta/capability`). That is the reader `RecipientPickerField` already uses for the `position` registry; there is no object-name special case. It no longer calls `dataSource.find` on `sys_capability`. No second list is merged in; the existing union with the set's own selections stays, so a granted name the registry does not serve is still shown, selected, under "Other". The grouping by scope and the curated client-side labels are unchanged. Without a metadata store the picker offers the set's own selections and loads nothing (no endless "Loading capabilities…" line). The host, `PermissionMatrixEditor`, no longer passes the adapter to it. The ten locale packs' comments that said the labels come from "the sys_capability registry" now say "the capability registry".

**Row 1b: the Capabilities catalog page.** Measured in a browser (below): `/apps/setup/metadata/capability?scope=environment` already renders the capability registry read-only, with no code change. It lists all 11 items, with no "New" button, no active switch, no status filter and no `sys_capability` read, and an item opens locked with no Save. So the change is documentation only. `SETUP_CATALOG_TYPES` keeps `capability` out ON PURPOSE: the constant names the types with an activation switch (`hasCatalogActivation` reads it), and the activation door refuses a capability. Adding it, the "smallest change" the census named, would put a switch on that page that every click refuses. The ablation below shows that. Its docblock and the app-shell README said the page "still reads `sys_capability` rows"; they now say what it serves.

**The URL for objectstack's stage 8:** `nav_capabilities` should point at `/apps/setup/metadata/capability?scope=environment`, the same scope-carrying form `SystemCatalogRedirect` uses for positions and permission sets. objectstack's nav is not changed here.

**F2: the provenance badge.** The identity strip's badge now also reads `codeIsArtifact`, the layered-envelope verdict the artifact lock already reads. A set a code package ships reads "Package" beside its "Read-only (this set is provided by a code package)" lock. Before this change it read "Custom", because the registry serves no `managedBy` and the environment scope passes no `packageId`. The badge gains `data-testid="perm-provenance-badge"`.

## Measured on a fresh showcase

objectstack `origin/main` 8532783f65 (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`, showcase), with this branch's console served by vite against it, signed in as the seeded admin. Before = the two changed source files at the base commit a7d492011 (the A1 mutation below); after = this branch.

- **The registry, by the API.** `GET /api/v1/meta/capability` lists 11 items: the 9 curated `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` (`_packageId` `com.objectstack.plugin-security`) and 2 that the showcase package declares (`showcase.export_data`, `showcase.restricted_ops`). `GET /api/v1/data/sys_capability` answers `total: 0`; the control `GET /api/v1/data/sys_user` answers rows.
- **Item 1, an environment-authored set that grants `setup.access`.** Before: one chip, "Setup Access", under "Other". The request was `GET /api/v1/data/sys_capability?top=500&filter=…active…`. After: 11 chips. Platform: Manage Metadata, Manage Platform Settings, Manage Users, Setup Access (on), Studio Access. Organization: Export Showcase Data, Manage Organization Users, Manage Sharing, Restricted Showcase Operations, View All Audit Log, Write Settings. The one capability request was `GET /api/v1/meta/capability`.
- **Row 1b.** The page and the item reading above were the same before and after.
- **F2.** `showcase_ops` and `admin_full_access` at the environment scope. Before: "Custom" beside the lock. After: "Package" beside the lock. The environment-authored probe set reads "Custom" both times.

## Tests

New and updated pins, each red against an ablation, with the restore proven on disk:

- `CapabilityMultiSelectField.test.tsx` — a new describe block, "the options are the capability registry (objectui#7611)", with three cases: it lists the registry items, curated and package-declared, and never asks a handed-in data source for rows; it adds a package-declared capability by name; with no store, it offers only the selections and does not sit on the loading line. The file's existing cases and `CapabilityMultiSelectField.specParity-6285.test.tsx` now feed the registry through a store instead of a mocked `sys_capability` data source.
- `PermissionMatrixEditor.provenanceBadge-7611.test.tsx` (new) — a code-package set reads "Package" beside its lock. Three controls still read "Custom": no code layer, an organization-authored set with a code-looking `_packageId`, and the `sys_metadata` sentinel.
- `ResourceListPage.environmentScope-7611.test.tsx` — a new describe block for the Capabilities page: every registry item is listed with the scope kept; no create, no status filter and no switch; no request to the ledger or to `sys_capability`.

Ablations, one per pin, each run from a committed state:

- **A1:** `CapabilityMultiSelectField.tsx` set back to its base blob (`git checkout` of a7d492011, unstaged; on disk the registry read counts 0 and the row read 1, and the blob equals the base blob). Result: 9 failed, 11 passed, including all three new registry cases. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --` on the absolute path; the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- **A2:** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` deleting ` || codeIsArtifact` from the badge (anchor 1 → 0). Result: 1 failed (Expected "Package", Received "Custom"), and the 3 controls passed. Restored; the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. A first attempt replaced the condition with a substring of itself; the tool refused it before running anything because the replacement count did not rise, so that attempt was a no-op.
- **A3:** `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` adding `'capability'` to `SETUP_CATALOG_TYPES`. Result: the 1b case failed (the status filter rendered) and the other 11 passed. Restored the same way.

## Local verification at `0070a807e`

Every run below was on HEAD `0070a807e`, the branch's last commit. Builds and tests went through the shared verify lock. The verdict quoted is the one each tool printed.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/` — 244 files passed and 1 skipped; 3979 tests passed and 7 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` plus the 16 test files outside that directory that name a touched module (found with `git grep`; console, studio-design, plugin-detail, data-objectstack, schema-catalog and fields) — 488 files passed; 5512 tests passed and 1 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/` — 82 files passed; 1316 tests passed and 13 skipped.
- `pnpm turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'` — 28 of 28 tasks succeeded. It ran first so that the type checks read freshly built typings.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check`, `@object-ui/i18n` and `@object-ui/app-shell` — each exited 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFilesOnly` lists the new and changed test files in both packages.
- eslint with the root config and `--no-inline-config` on the 17 changed TS files (counted from `--format json`): 0 errors. Type-aware linting is not configured (`eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file. Repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- Gates, each exit 0: changeset presence and no-major, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:control-bytes`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unused-deps` and `check:phantom-deps`. `check-governed-queue-guard --test` on the 19 paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:readme-exports`. Its prerequisite was not met: it needs every package's `dist` typings, and it refused with "the population COLLAPSED" (36 of 40 packages unbuilt). This PR touches only prose in a README, not a code fence. CI builds and runs it.

Narrowed, and declared as narrowed: the app-shell package's own suite was not run whole. CI runs it.

## Acceptance notes

- On a framework from before objectstack#22669, the registry serves only the package-declared capabilities. There the picker offers the curated ones only where a set already grants them, while that framework still has `sys_capability` rows. The changeset says so. The objectui#7611 line targets the v18 framework, where the registry serves all of them.
